content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"player_at":{"x":11,"y":1}}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight-adjacent","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"monster_on_faced_tile":true}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"swing"}},{"id":"flee","priority":9,"when":{"all":[{"monster_within":2}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"evade"}},{"id":"navigate-to-ladder","priority":5,"when":{"all":[{"always":true}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"climb-mine"}}],"skills":[{"name":"swing","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); const m = ms.find(m => Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y)===1); if (m) { await b.faceAndPress(m.x, m.y, 'ControllerX', 0); } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'swung'})"},{"name":"evade","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); if (!ms.length) return {ok:true}; let best=null, bd=-1; for (const m of ms) { const d=Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y); if (d>bd){bd=d;best=m;} } let tx=p.x, ty=p.y; const dx=p.x-best.x, dy=p.y-best.y; if (Math.abs(dx)>=Math.abs(dy)) tx=p.x+(dx>=0?1:-1); else ty=p.y+(dy>=0?1:-1); tx=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,tx)); ty=Math.max(0,Math.min(9,ty)); await b.walkTo(tx,ty,'stand'); return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'evaded'})"},{"name":"climb-mine","skill":"async (b) => { const path=[[2,8],[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const p=await b.body(); if (p.x===x && p.y===y) continue; const ms=await b.monsters(); const near=ms.find(m=>Math.abs(m.x-x)<=1 && Math.abs(m.y-y)<=1); if (near) { await b.faceAndPress(near.x,near.y,'ControllerX',0); } const r=await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => { const p=await b.body(); return {ok:p.x===11&&p.y===1, detail:'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"}]}
